From e5e252ba21d243689a8e8bf2af5bf5579dabfea7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Luo Jiaxing <luojiaxing@huawei.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2020 16:08:15 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] net: ethernet: mlx4: Avoid assigning a value to ring_cons but
 not used it anymore in mlx4_en_xmit()

We found a set but not used variable 'ring_cons' in mlx4_en_xmit(), it will
cause a warning when build the kernel. And after checking the commit record
of this function, we found that it was introduced by a previous patch.

So, We delete this redundant assignment code.

Fixes: 488a9b48e398 ("net/mlx4_en: Wake TX queues only when there's enough room")

Signed-off-by: Luo Jiaxing <luojiaxing@huawei.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/en_tx.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/en_tx.c
index 9dff7b086c9f..d55434449c0c 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/en_tx.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/en_tx.c
@@ -1075,7 +1075,6 @@ netdev_tx_t mlx4_en_xmit(struct sk_buff *skb, struct net_device *dev)
 		 */
 		smp_rmb();
 
-		ring_cons = READ_ONCE(ring->cons);
 		if (unlikely(!mlx4_en_is_tx_ring_full(ring))) {
 			netif_tx_wake_queue(ring->tx_queue);
 			ring->wake_queue++;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx4/en_tx.c`**
   - The line `ring_cons = READ_ONCE(ring->cons);` has been removed from the `mlx4_en_xmit` function. This variable `ring_cons` was previously assigned a value but was not used anywhere in the function, leading to a compiler warning.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a specific issue identified in the code where a variable was set but not utilized, which can lead to unnecessary warnings during the kernel build process. The change is a cleanup that enhances code quality by removing redundant code, and it is linked to a previous commit (identified by the Fixes tag) that introduced the unused variable. This patch improves the maintainability of the code by eliminating unused assignments.
